## 407095d514a9

**Reproduced defect — advertised exact controls are ignored, and unknown overrides are accepted.**

At generator SHA-256 `919becd3e80b8faf1fd084a3915fb51f68b165fa042d3d68b8a470bc10feaa4f`, the calls below all returned the same 17×14 grid with six color-2 cells and an empty `self_check` result:

- `grid_h=11` and `grid_h=22`
- `grid_w=11` and `grid_w=24`
- `core_size=3` and `core_size=12`
- unknown key `__override_contract_unknown_axis__="x"`

The complete source-bound reproducer is `checks/audit/407095d514a9/override_reproducer.json`. The official override stage independently produced more than 79,000 findings and reported the accepted unknown key in `checks/audit/407095d514a9/override/checks/407095d514a9_before_override.log`. Lint also reports a missing required `RULE_HASH` in `checks/audit/407095d514a9/lint/checks/407095d514a9_before_lint.log`.

This is an audit-only finding; no target files were changed. I did not claim a Racket semantic counterexample because the reproduced defect is the generator's control contract.
